page.layout: One printed page, left part of a title opening: a woodcut frieze at the top, then the title lines in capitals and italic, then a large woodcut initial P with the first lines of text beside and below it. No margin notes visible. Only the left part of the page is on this scan.; One block of text in the left part of the scan, a large title with a woodcut ornament above it, a historiated initial at the start of the paragraph; the printed page continues to the left and the right side is blank. No marginal notes.
page.notes: The title lines are cut off at the right edge of this part; the continuation lies in the other part. The initial P is a large woodcut; its letter is taken as P. Several words at the line ends are cut and are given as printed on this part only. The left part of the scan is cut off; the first line of the title and the start of the lines are incomplete. The large initial R is a woodcut letter. The catchword "I. Theo-" is a line at the foot of the text, read as a signature-line word and left in the text.
